source: The Arc pool ARCT fixture, matching this package's own acceptance test pair address ('fork/fixture Arc pool ARCT 0x4443…0c8e') exactly. NOT independently re-read on-chain for this fixture: Arc coverage is fork/fixture-driven (real-money UAT for this SDK is Base only), and this fixture is consumed here purely by resolveCollection.test.ts's mocked-multicall unit tests, never a live RPC call. quoteToken is the USDC ERC-20 predeploy (6 decimals) — Arc has no wUSDC; the native balance and this ERC-20 view are the same balance (chains/registry.ts, chainId 5042).
